name: 20777 · Highland, MD
findings: ZIP 20777 (Highland) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20777 (Highland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
